words.meaning: A pleasant smell that frequently accompanies the first rain after a long period of warm, dry weather
words.sentence1: The sudden summer storm brought a refreshing petrichor to the dry earth. (The sudden summer storm brought a refreshing earthy scent to the dry ground.)
words.sentence2: She closed her eyes and deeply inhaled the rich petrichor rising from the pavement. (She closed her eyes and deeply inhaled the rich earthy scent rising from the pavement.)

words.meaning: The early morning hours, dawn, or daybreak
words.sentence1: Salimos de viaje en plena madrugada para evitar el trafico. (We left on our trip in the dead of the early morning to avoid the traffic.)
words.sentence2: El canto de los pajaros comienza en la madrugada. (The singing of the birds begins at dawn.)

words.meaning: Light rain consisting of tiny droplets; drizzle
words.sentence1: Une fine bruine enveloppait la foret endormie. (A fine drizzle enveloped the sleeping forest.)
words.sentence2: Il prefere marcher sous la bruine automnale sans parapluie. (He prefers to walk in the autumn drizzle without an umbrella.)

words.meaning: A cloud of tiny water droplets suspended in the atmosphere at or near the earth's surface; fog
words.sentence1: Der dichte Nebel ver barg die herbstlichen baeume. (The dense fog hid the autumn trees.)
words.sentence2: Am morgen lichtete sich der Nebel langsam ueber dem See. (In the morning the fog slowly cleared over the lake.)

words.meaning: The cold wind that announces the arrival of winter
words.sentence1: Kogarashi ga fuku to kisetsu wa fuyu ni kawaru. (When the cold winter wind blows, the season changes to winter.)
words.sentence2: Kogarashi no oto ga mado o yurasu yoru datta. (It was a night when the sound of the cold winter wind shook the window.)

words.meaning: A hot, dust-laden Mediterranean wind coming from the Sahara
words.sentence1: Lo scirocco porta sabbia rossa dal deserto africano. (The sirocco brings red sand from the African desert.)
words.sentence2: Durante lo scirocco l'aria diventa umida e pesante. (During the sirocco the air becomes humid and heavy.)

words.sentence1: Chuntian de shihou, yuanzi li de mulanhua zhengkai le. (In springtime, the magnolia flowers in the courtyard have bloomed.)
words.sentence2: Mulan de xiangwei zai chunfeng zhong piao dong. (The fragrance of the magnolia drifts in the spring breeze.)

words.meaning: An afterglow or sunset glow in the sky
words.sentence1: Jeonyeok noraeul-i haneul-eul붉ge muldeuligo issda. (The evening afterglow is coloring the sky red.)
words.sentence2: Bada wi-ro pyeolchyeojin noraeul-i cham areumdapda. (The afterglow spreading over the sea is truly beautiful.)

words.meaning: Rain or rainfall, especially during the monsoon season
words.sentence1: Phleang vreak nih chuoy daoy chraen samrab srov knong srae. (This monsoon rain helps a lot for the rice in the fields.)
words.sentence2: Procheaschon niyeay tha rogvak vreak pteab ptean chuoy pka chhouk. (People say that the steady seasonal rain nurtures the lotus flowers.)

words.meaning: A storm characterized by the presence of lightning and thunder, common in summer
words.sentence1: 'n Somerse donderstorm het skielik oor die vlaktes losgebreek. (A summer thunderstorm suddenly broke out over the plains.)
words.sentence2: Die weerligstrale tydens die donderstorm was asemrowend mooi. (The lightning bolts during the thunderstorm were breathtakingly beautiful.)
